integrity: Proof uses canonical blocks, a sign-change argument, explicit Chebyshev Wronskians, and the implicit function theorem; finite diagnostics are supplementary and not evidence of an infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Complex Hilbert spaces; equal finite projection ranks; k fixed distinct scales within (0,1); identification of unitary orbit, not oriented pair; no conditioning or noise stability; generalized equal-weight quadrature implications remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp finite trace-norm tomography of principal angles between two equal-rank projections
